items: On the sea chart, lakes follow their island's land: frozen in the far north, lava in the volcanic east, oases in the southern desert, dark sinkholes in the western jungle; glacial tarns with ice floes, steaming hot springs, rust-red pools ringed with terraces and lily ponds on the islands between
The sea chart shows the islands at their true sizes, packed over the whole sea, each coast following its neighbour's across a narrow strait
